skill.name: kuaishou-content-research
skill.description: Retrieve Kuaishou hot searches and sample videos by keyword through SocialDataX. Compare topics and content examples using visible engagement metrics and source links.
skill.summary: Research Kuaishou topics with current rankings and traceable video samples.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most backtick hits are Markdown, but several instructions invoke an unpinned npm package that handles SocialDataX credentials. The CLI examples leave shell argument handling unspecified, and billing guidance lacks explicit validation for links supplied in errors. No evidence found of bundled secrets, obfuscation, or prompt injection targeting the audit.

remediation.issue: The CLI downloads and runs an unpinned package with access to SocialDataX credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer an authorized MCP connection. For CLI use, pin a reviewed release, verify its package integrity, and require approval before downloading or running it.

remediation.issue: The CLI reads a persistent credential file and can inherit secrets from its environment.
remediation.suggestion: Use an OS credential store for persistence and pass only the scoped service credential to the verified CLI. Do not inherit unrelated secrets.

remediation.issue: CLI examples do not define a safe way to pass user keywords or service-provided pagination tokens.
remediation.suggestion: Pass keywords and tokens as separate arguments without shell evaluation, or send them as structured MCP parameters. Do not interpolate them into shell command strings.

remediation.issue: The billing workflow may surface a link supplied in an error and resume requests that use credits.
remediation.suggestion: Use the fixed provider dashboard or verify the exact HTTPS host and path. Ask for confirmation before resuming requests that may consume credits.

content.value_statement: Kuaishou rankings and keyword results answer different questions, so comparing them takes time. This skill separates current hot topics from traceable video samples and summarizes the evidence for your next decision.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve ranked Kuaishou hot topics and any available popularity signals.
Search Kuaishou videos for a focused keyword or topic.
Collect a bounded sample across pages when the service returns a continuation token.
Retain available video IDs, share links, creators, publication times, and visible engagement metrics.
Compare themes and content formats across samples while separating observations from interpretations.
limitations: Live results require authorized SocialDataX access through the CLI or an authenticated MCP connection.
Provider requests may consume credits and can stop when the account balance is insufficient.
Search has no stable, complete result boundary, and rankings reflect only the current snapshot.
Research actions are read-only and do not post, like, comment, or change Kuaishou accounts.

use_cases.title: Plan topics for a content calendar
use_cases.description: Review the current hot-search list and identify topics that fit your audience.

use_cases.title: Compare two brands in search
use_cases.description: Use comparable video samples to identify recurring topics, formats, and visible engagement for each brand.

use_cases.title: Find examples for a new video
use_cases.description: Review videos for one topic and keep the creator names and links needed to revisit useful references.

prompt_templates.title: Review the current hot list
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the top five topics on the current Kuaishou hot-search list. Include the rank and any available popularity signal.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Check current topics without choosing a keyword.

prompt_templates.title: Sample one keyword
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Kuaishou for balcony gardening. Review only the first page and keep up to ten videos with their titles, creators, and available share links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: Collect a small set of examples for a known topic.

prompt_templates.title: Compare two search samples
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Kuaishou videos for foldable bikes and commuter bikes. Use at most two pages per keyword and separate visible engagement from your interpretation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Compare two topics with consistent limits.

prompt_templates.title: Build a traceable trend brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Keep the current hot list separate from searches for home fitness and strength training. Review up to three pages per term and stop after 20 results per term. Cite links or IDs, report partial results, and identify two questions for further research.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Combine ranking signals with bounded search evidence.

output_examples.input: Show me the current Kuaishou hot-search list and identify topics relevant to a home cooking creator.
output: Illustrative ranking, not live data: Quick dinners, rank 3. Lunchbox ideas, rank 8.
Interpretation: Both topics fit short recipe videos. Ranking alone does not show which format viewers prefer.

output_examples.input: Review the first page of balcony gardening videos and suggest a follow-up search.
output: Illustrative sample: Container setup and watering schedules recur in the reviewed videos.
Evidence to retain: Video title, creator, share link or video ID, and any visible engagement metrics.
Next search: Shade-tolerant balcony plants. The first page alone does not establish a platform-wide trend.

best_practices: Start with one page and set a clear result limit before asking for more.
Keep rankings separate from keyword results, and distinguish visible evidence from interpretation.
Use an authorized connection, keep credentials out of chat, and verify billing destinations independently.
anti_patterns: Treating one hot list or a small search sample as a complete view of Kuaishou.
Changing an opaque pagination token or reusing it with a different keyword.
Pasting an API key, authorization header, or credential file into the conversation.

faq.question: What is the difference between hot search and keyword search?
faq.answer: Hot search lists current ranked topics without a keyword. Keyword search returns video samples for a specific term.

faq.question: Do I need a SocialDataX key?
faq.answer: The CLI needs an available SocialDataX credential. An authenticated hosted MCP connection does not require a separate local CLI key.

faq.question: Can it retrieve every matching video?
faq.answer: No. Search has no stable completeness boundary, so use a page or item limit and treat the results as a sample.

faq.question: What happens if a request fails after returning some results?
faq.answer: The skill keeps the items already returned and marks the output as incomplete. It can resume the same search if a valid continuation token remains.

faq.question: Can the skill post or interact with videos?
faq.answer: No. Its Kuaishou research actions are read-only.

faq.question: What should I do if my balance is insufficient?
faq.answer: Stop retrying and check the balance in your SocialDataX dashboard. Resume only after confirming that the active connection uses the correct account.
